verdict.rationale: Mastra Code documents its own mechanisms for extending the agent with external tools: MCP server configs, merged with file-based configs, and custom tools added alongside the built-in set. Either could plausibly connect workflow tools, but no evidence names Jira, Slack, Google Drive or any ready-made workflow-tool connector. missing for 10: documented Jira/Slack/Google Drive integrations or examples, setup docs for connecting workflow tools via MCP, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can connect the agent to workflow tools like Jira, Slack, and Google Drive to extend its context
